name: Country Blossom Farm
description: Country Blossom Farm is an pumpkin patch in Alexandria, MN. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Pumpkins, and Squash, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
